Clayton Sharpe is a gun-for-hire residing in Deadwood. He is played by Matthew Mercer. Anola is the woman who handled the mass cooking for the village of Vo on Rumblecusp. As an NPC, Anola is played by Matthew Mercer. Ferris , more commonly known as Flimsy, is a shapeshifter sorcerer who joined the Darrington Brigade for their job performing security for the maiden voyage of the skyship "Hubris". He was played by Matthew Mercer.

page.overview:
Who is Matthew Mercer?

Matthew Mercer is a fictionalized version of voice actor Matthew Mercer for Taliesin Jaffe's one-shot, . This version of Matthew Mercer was played by Matthew Mercer.

Taliesin's amusement at Matthew before the break in Episode One was in relation to the ability Ashes to Ashes, that is part of the Oblivion Discipline.
